name: kalam-api
description: Soma's gate, from a runner. NEVER set `retry_non_idempotent` here: two gate routes MINT a claim rather than present one, so a retry does not repeat a call, it takes a second row. `soma-gate-claim` sets a fresh `claim_token` under FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, so each retry claims a DIFFERENT pending match and the runner only ever learns the last token -- the others sit claimed for the whole lease, hold `max_in_flight`, and the reap fails them LEASE_LAPSED, never played. `soma-gate-admissions-claim` does `attempts = attempts + 1`, so each one burns a different submission's attempt until it expires TIMED_OUT unprobed. Orion allows the flag only with a workflow-set idempotency key, and this set has none. The retry block itself is fine: it covers the GETs and the token exchange.
